column1: # Hand-written additions to the Moby-derived dictionary: valid common English words (or parts of speech) that the lower-case Moby list lacks.
# A word that exists gains the listed parts of speech after its own; a new word is added. The inflections of an added word are generated like any other.

# Evidence: gutenberg = ordinary word frequent in the Project Gutenberg sample of tools/real-text; british = British spelling of a word the list has in US spelling; archaic = archaic spelling; proper = day, month, nationality or country name that the lower-case list lacks.
